We are open to your professional recommendation.

If you believe there is a better, more stable or cheaper way than Make.com, please propose it in your application, for example:
• Direct ActiveCampaign automation
• Pabbly Connect
• n8n
• Custom webhook + server
• Zoho native workflow
• Any hybrid solution

We want the most reliable long-term solution, not just the quickest.

⸻

Deliverables

• Fully working automation (Make or your proposed platform)
• Proper filters (to avoid accidental sends)
• Mapping of all ActiveCampaign custom fields
• Zoho Mail integration
• Error handling (missing fields, no collection date etc.)
• Short handover video showing staff how to use it

⸻

Required Skills
• Automation platforms (Make / Pabbly / n8n etc.)
• ActiveCampaign CRM automation
• Zoho Mail integration
• OpenAI API usage
• Webhooks & filtering logic
• Experience with approval flows

⸻

Important Rules
• Email must ONLY use data from CRM – no invented info
• If a field is empty → remove that line
• Must use UK English
• Must not include “vehicle extras”
• Staff must be able to review before send

⸻

Budget

(We will hire quickly for the right person)

⸻

1. Have you built ActiveCampaign + AI + email automation before?
2. How would you handle “staff review before send”?
3. Would you use Make.com or a better method?
4. Estimated time to complete
5. Example of similar automation you’ve built

Title: Applied AI Engineer for Vertex AI Knowledgebases
Description:
We’re looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to help us design and implement an AI-powered internal knowledge base built on Google Cloud / Vertex AI.

This is not a customer support chatbot and not a client-facing agent. It’s an internal, operations-focused system used by designers, account managers, and PMs to aggregate, organize, and query brand, account, product, and project information.

We currently support ~60 brands/clients. And need to create siloed knowledge bases for each. With each acting as a single source of truth.

What we’re building:

We want a Vertex AI–backed knowledge system that lets our team dump large volumes of mixed data into one place and then ask natural-language questions to get clear, context-aware, brand-specific answers.

The goal is simple:
Stop people from digging through, messages, Google Drive, folders, and old docs just to understand an account or brand.

This system should prioritize reliability, simplicity, and real-world usability over experimental or over-engineered AI.

Core requirements:
A key requirement is zero-friction ingestion. We need to be able to routinely drop in documents, PDFs, spreadsheets, images, links, and other unstructured content without manual tagging, labeling, or routing. The system should automatically ingest the data, extract useful information (including OCR and basic vision for images), index it appropriately, and make it queryable.

The system must support multiple fully isolated knowledge bases (up to ~80), one per brand or client, with clean permission boundaries. With the ability to spin up new KBs easily when needed

Automated ingestion is required. This includes syncing from Google Drive and using tools like Zapier, n8n, or similar pipelines. The system must handle new files, updates, and re-indexing as content changes.

Query experience:
We want a simple, natural-language query interface (chat-style is fine) for internal use. Queries are operational, not support-based. Typical use cases include summarizing brand rules, synthesizing product information, understanding past project decisions, and surfacing constraints before starting work.

Answers must be accurate, brand-specific, and grounded in source material.

Platform expectations (Important):

This system is expected to be built using Google Cloud and Vertex AI.
Strong familiarity with:
-Vertex AI (models, embeddings, agents, or RAG-style architectures)
-Google Workspace ingestion (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Shared Drives, Gmail where appropriate)
-Google Cloud IAM and permissions


Scope
-This is Phase 1 only. The focus is on:
-Knowledge base architecture
-Ingestion (manual + automated)
-Automated organization and indexing
-Query interface
-Initial KB rollout

Client-facing agents, advanced AI orchestration, PM software integration, and heavy analytics are out of scope for now.

What success looks like:
This project is successful if teams can reliably find answers without digging through Drive, quickly synthesize large volumes of data, and naturally adopt the KB as the default place to start when working on an account.

Who this is for:
You’re a strong fit if you’ve built production-grade, retrieval-based AI systems (not demos), are comfortable with messy real-world data, and can make good architectural decisions without overbuilding.

I’m a licensed chiropractor in Canada looking for a dependable, coachable virtual assistant to create professional screen-recorded videos for my patients. This is a steady, long-term remote role with consistent weekly volume.

What you’ll be doing:
Record clear, professional screen-capture videos using scripts and pre-written reports I prepare.

Two main video types:

Report of Findings videos — usually 10–15 minutes (explaining exam results, diagnosis, care plan)

Progress Report videos — usually 5–10 minutes (reviewing progress, adjustments, next steps)

Target volume: 25–35 videos per week (mix of both types based on clinic schedule)

Deliver all recordings in clear, friendly, professional Canadian English (neutral Canadian accent strongly preferred)

Read from provided scripts/reports accurately while maintaining a natural, empathetic tone

Follow precise instructions for pacing, emphasis, pronunciation of chiropractic/medical terms, and overall delivery

Learn and follow our workflow, including:

- Remoting securely into our office computer (via AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or similar)

- Accessing patient files/data in a HIPAA/PIPEDA-compliant manner

- Using screen recording software (we’ll train you on our preferred tool — Loom)

- Proper file naming, exporting, and uploading
Sending completed videos to patients through our secure portal/email system

Key requirements:

- Full training and onboarding provided (1–2 weeks of guided practice, feedback, and shadowing)

- You must be highly coachable, take feedback well, and quickly improve to meet our quality standard

- 100% remote — work from anywhere with reliable high-speed internet

- Quiet recording environment with no background noise

- Strict confidentiality required (you will sign an NDA and handle protected health information)

This is an ideal role for someone with experience in voice-over, narration, medical/customer service scripting, virtual assisting, or any position requiring excellent spoken English and attention to detail.

If you have a clear Canadian (or very neutral North American) accent, are reliable, and want consistent weekly work, please apply!

Scope of Work

Ongoing weekly production of 25–35 patient videos

Flexible hours within the week (must complete quota reliably)

Script reading with natural, warm delivery

Basic file management and secure delivery

Initial weekly feedback sessions (Zoom), then occasional check-ins

Long-term partnership preferred (potential to add other VA tasks later)

Skills Required

Excellent spoken Canadian English (or extremely clear, neutral North American English with strong Canadian pronunciation)

Experience with screen recording tools (OBS Studio, Loom, Camtasia, etc.)

Clear, professional voice with good articulation and pacing

Ability to read scripts accurately and take direction well

Comfort using remote desktop software

Quiet workspace and stable, fast internet

High attention to detail and strong coachability

Bonus: Previous voice-over, narration, explainer video, healthcare admin, or customer-facing video experience

Timeline / Engagement Type

Long-term / ongoing

Start: Ideally within 2–4 weeks after successful training

Weekly commitment: Approximately 15–25 hours/week (varies with volume)

Budget / Rate

Hourly rate: $20–25 CAD per hour 

Starting rate depends on your experience in similar roles (voice-over, narration, scripted recording, medical admin) 

Higher end ($23–25 CAD) for candidates who demonstrate excellent Canadian English, quick learning, and high-quality recordings during test/onboarding 

Weekly payments based on hours tracked and approved videos

Please state your requested starting rate in your proposal (within the $20–25 CAD range) and briefly explain why you believe you qualify for the higher end if asking above $20.

Title: N8N WhatsApp Chatbot - Fix Webhook Trigger Issue

I need an experienced N8N + WhatsApp API developer to diagnose and fix this webhook authentication issue via screen share. Should be a quick fix for someone who knows these platforms well.

**Required:** N8N experience, WhatsApp Business API/Meta Cloud API knowledge, webhook troubleshooting skills.

Title: Build ScoutLink – Recruiter & Scouting SaaS Integrated with PlayerRank (Bubble.io + Airtable)
Description:
We run PlayerRank, a live player-facing platform built on Bubble.io with Airtable as the backend, where players upload game videos and purchase automated stat tracking.

We are now building a separate SaaS platform called ScoutLink.

ScoutLink is NOT for players.
It is for scouts, coaches, team managers, agents, and league owners.
These users will log into ScoutLink (not PlayerRank).

ScoutLink will read verified player data from PlayerRank via Airtable / APIs and provide tools for:
• creating player requirements (not public job posts)
• advanced player search & filtering
• shortlisting & pipelines
• controlled “apply” workflows
• Upwork-style contact control (no direct messaging until accepted)
• strong admin oversight

You are not rebuilding PlayerRank.
You are building ScoutLink alongside an existing Bubble.io app.

Core features
• Recruiter dashboard (players requiring attention, watchlists)
• Opportunity creation with location & travel requirements
• Filters: age, position, height, location, travel willingness, games tracked, data freshness
• Players can apply but cannot message
• Recruiters invite to connect; contact happens via platform-controlled chat or meeting links
• Full audit logs and rate limits
• Admin panel to approve/block contacts and monitor activity

Required changes to PlayerRank (limited scope)
• Add structured fields: location, travel willingness, availability
• Eligibility logic for applications
• Expose read-only APIs / Airtable views to ScoutLink

Must-have experience
• SaaS platforms with role separation
• Admin dashboards
• Airtable API integration
• Comfortable working alongside Bubble.io
• Secure workflow & permission design

Please include
1. Relevant SaaS/admin work
2. Airtable or no-code integration experience
3. How you’d design controlled recruiter–player contact
4. How you’d architect ScoutLink next to Bubble.io

We run PlayerRank, a live player-facing platform built on Bubble.io with Airtable as the backend, where players upload game videos and purchase automated stat tracking.

We are now building a separate SaaS platform called ScoutLink.

ScoutLink is NOT for players.
It is for scouts, coaches, team managers, agents, and league owners.
These users will log into ScoutLink (not PlayerRank).

ScoutLink will read verified player data from PlayerRank via Airtable / APIs and provide tools for:
• creating player requirements (not public job posts)
• advanced player search & filtering
• shortlisting & pipelines
• controlled “apply” workflows
• Upwork-style contact control (no direct messaging until accepted)
• strong admin oversight

You are not rebuilding PlayerRank.
You are building ScoutLink alongside an existing Bubble.io app.

Core features
• Recruiter dashboard (players requiring attention, watchlists)
• Opportunity creation with location & travel requirements
• Filters: age, position, height, location, travel willingness, games tracked, data freshness
• Players can apply but cannot message
• Recruiters invite to connect; contact happens via platform-controlled chat or meeting links
• Full audit logs and rate limits
• Admin panel to approve/block contacts and monitor activity

Required changes to PlayerRank (limited scope)
• Add structured fields: location, travel willingness, availability
• Eligibility logic for applications
• Expose read-only APIs / Airtable views to ScoutLink

Must-have experience
• SaaS platforms with role separation
• Admin dashboards
• Airtable API integration
• Comfortable working alongside Bubble.io
• Secure workflow & permission design

Please include
1. Relevant SaaS/admin work
2. Airtable or no-code integration experience
3. How you’d design controlled recruiter–player contact
4. How you’d architect ScoutLink next to Bubble.io

Title: Automation Expert Needed: Shopify Bulk AI Lifestyle Image Generation (Flux/Leonardo API + Make.com)
Description:
I am looking for an automation expert to build a scalable workflow that generates high-quality lifestyle/ambient images for Shopify products based on reference images.

The Goal: I want to be able to select products (via a Google Sheet or Excel), define a reference "style" image per category, and automatically generate new product images where my original product is placed in a new, AI-generated setting.

The Workflow:

Trigger: A list of Product IDs in Google Sheets with a URL for a reference image.

Fetch: Pull the main product image (clean background) from Shopify via API.

Generate: Use an AI API (e.g., Flux.1, Leonardo.ai, or Google Nano Banana) to generate a new lifestyle image using the product image + reference image for style/setting.

Upload: Push the generated image back to the corresponding Shopify product.

Technical Requirements:

Experience with Shopify API.

Expertise in Make.com or n8n.

Experience with AI Image APIs (Flux, Stable Diffusion, or Leonardo.ai).

Ability to ensure product consistency (the product should look like the original, just in a new setting).

To Apply: Please describe a similar automation you have built and which AI model you recommend for maintaining the highest product integrity.

Title: Senior AI Automation & Agentic Systems Architect (n8n + LangGraph)
Description:
Overview

We are building an institutional-grade Agentic Infrastructure for a capital advisory firm operating under a 1 Founder + Offshore Talent + Agentic Infrastructure model.

This is not a chatbot project.
This is not a Zapier automation role.

We are looking for an experienced builder who can design and implement production-ready AI agents using:
• n8n as the execution and integration backbone
• LangGraph as the reasoning and decision engine

The system will support:
• Capital raises
• Investor pipelines
• Strategic exit processes
• Client portals and data rooms
• Internal operating systems
• Offshore team execution

This is high-stakes financial infrastructure. Accuracy, guardrails, and auditability matter.

What You’ll Be Building

You will help architect and implement an Agentic Infrastructure that includes:
• Multi-step, stateful AI agents (LangGraph)
• Deterministic workflows with human-in-the-loop approvals (n8n)
• Agent-driven research, summaries, monitoring, and reporting
• Integration with tools such as:
• Slack
• Loom
• Fathom
• Google Drive / data rooms
• CRMs and internal dashboards
• Exception handling, logging, and escalation logic
• Clear separation between:
• Agent execution
• Offshore human QA
• Founder decision authority

You will not be responsible for frontend design or branding.
This is a systems + logic + orchestration role.

Required Experience (Non-Negotiable)

Please do not apply unless you have:
• Proven experience with n8n (self-hosted or cloud)
• Proven experience building multi-step AI agents (LangGraph strongly preferred)
• Experience integrating LLMs into real workflows (not demos)
• Strong understanding of:
• Human-in-the-loop design
• Error handling and retries
• Workflow observability
• Comfort working with sensitive data (finance, ops, client communications)

Bonus (strong preference):
• Experience in finance, ops, PE, VC, SaaS, or agency infrastructure
• Experience designing agent systems for non-technical operators
• Familiarity with client portals or internal OS-style dashboards

What This Is NOT
• Not prompt engineering only
• Not AutoGPT-style “let it run” agents
• Not Zapier-only automation
• Not a quick MVP or demo

We are building durable infrastructure, not experiments.

Engagement Details
• Initial scope: Architecture + first wave of core agents
• Timeline: Phased build (weeks, not days)
• Engagement type: Contract (with potential long-term work)
• Budget: Competitive, based on experience (not looking for lowest bid)

We value:
• Clear thinking
• Documentation
• Guardrails
• Long-term maintainability

Why This Role Matters

This system will become the operating backbone of a capital advisory firm designed to scale without headcount bloat or founder burnout.

If you enjoy:
• Designing systems that replace teams
• Building agents that actually work in production
• Working directly with a founder on core infrastructure

Title: Automation Expert Needed: Shopify Bulk AI Lifestyle Image Generation (Flux/Leonardo API + Make.com)
Description:
I am looking for an automation expert to build a scalable workflow that generates high-quality lifestyle/ambient images for Shopify products based on reference images.

The Goal: I want to be able to select products (via a Google Sheet or Excel), define a reference "style" image per category, and automatically generate new product images where my original product is placed in a new, AI-generated setting.

The Workflow:

Trigger: A list of Product IDs in Google Sheets with a URL for a reference image.

Fetch: Pull the main product image (clean background) from Shopify via API.

Generate: Use an AI API (e.g., Flux.1, Leonardo.ai, or Google Nano Banana) to generate a new lifestyle image using the product image + reference image for style/setting.

Upload: Push the generated image back to the corresponding Shopify product.

Technical Requirements:

Experience with Shopify API.

Expertise in Make.com or n8n.

Experience with AI Image APIs (Flux, Stable Diffusion, or Leonardo.ai).

Ability to ensure product consistency (the product should look like the original, just in a new setting).

To Apply: Please describe a similar automation you have built and which AI model you recommend for maintaining the highest product integrity.

Title: Build ScoutLink – Recruiter & Scouting SaaS Integrated with PlayerRank (Bubble.io + Airtable)
Description:
We run PlayerRank, a live player-facing platform built on Bubble.io with Airtable as the backend, where players upload game videos and purchase automated stat tracking.

We are now building a separate SaaS platform called ScoutLink.

ScoutLink is NOT for players.
It is for scouts, coaches, team managers, agents, and league owners.
These users will log into ScoutLink (not PlayerRank).

ScoutLink will read verified player data from PlayerRank via Airtable / APIs and provide tools for:
• creating player requirements (not public job posts)
• advanced player search & filtering
• shortlisting & pipelines
• controlled “apply” workflows
• Upwork-style contact control (no direct messaging until accepted)
• strong admin oversight

You are not rebuilding PlayerRank.
You are building ScoutLink alongside an existing Bubble.io app.

Core features
• Recruiter dashboard (players requiring attention, watchlists)
• Opportunity creation with location & travel requirements
• Filters: age, position, height, location, travel willingness, games tracked, data freshness
• Players can apply but cannot message
• Recruiters invite to connect; contact happens via platform-controlled chat or meeting links
• Full audit logs and rate limits
• Admin panel to approve/block contacts and monitor activity

Required changes to PlayerRank (limited scope)
• Add structured fields: location, travel willingness, availability
• Eligibility logic for applications
• Expose read-only APIs / Airtable views to ScoutLink

Must-have experience
• SaaS platforms with role separation
• Admin dashboards
• Airtable API integration
• Comfortable working alongside Bubble.io
• Secure workflow & permission design

Please include
1. Relevant SaaS/admin work
2. Airtable or no-code integration experience
3. How you’d design controlled recruiter–player contact
4. How you’d architect ScoutLink next to Bubble.io

18. Test SDK behavior on multiple devices/browsers.

AI integration know-how (Gemini, Grok, etc.).
Workflow samples.
Availability (US Eastern Time preferred).
Time/cost estimate for the build.

Title: Build n8n Automation: TikTok/Instagram → AI Script → Avatar Video → Auto-Posting
Description:
I am looking for someone who can set up an N8N workflow that goes like this:

1. I send a TikTok or Instagram link to a Telegram bot
2. The bot will download the video with no watermark
3. The AI will analyze the video and make a transcript of it
4. Another AI will analyze the transcript and create a new transcript based on my prompt (I should be able to always adjust this prompt)
5. The script will be sent back to me on Telegram for approval, if I don't like it, I will ask for changes directly on telegram and the AI will make a new script. Repeat until I approve the final script.
6. A new video of an avatar reciting the approved script will be generated
7. The new avatar video will be overlaid on top of the old video.
8. The video will be sent back to me on telegram for approval.
9. Once approved, the video will be published on: YouTube shorts, Facebook, instagram, and TikTok.


To apply for this job, please answer the following questions:
1. What is 11+12? Please write the answer to this question in the first line of your application. This is how I filter SPAM.
2. What tools do you plan to use to create this flow?
3. Please give examples of further flows that you created in the past. Ideally, including N8N screenshots.
4. How long do you think it will take you to create this?
5. What should I expect each video to cost me in tokens?

Title: 📢 AI Voice & SMS Automation Developer
Description:
🧠 Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI automation developer to build and deploy an advanced AI voice and SMS outreach and lead qualification system for the real estate industry.

This project involves building both:

AI automation that follows up with inbound real estate leads

Outbound AI texting and calling automation that contacts real estate agents, qualifies them, and books sales calls

The system will integrate with VAPI, GoHighLevel, and high-volume SMS infrastructure, and must be designed for scalability, reliability, and long-term flexibility.

We are building a scalable real estate lead generation and marketplace ecosystem, so this project has strong long-term partnership potential.

🎯 Core Project Goals

The automation system will:

• Instantly call and text new inbound leads
• Qualify buyer and seller leads using AI conversations
• Route qualified leads to the correct real estate agents
• Book appointments automatically
• Conduct outbound AI calling and texting campaigns to recruit Realtors
• Qualify Realtors and book demo/sales calls
• Support high-volume cold SMS outreach in a compliant and scalable way
• Provide flexible workflow automation that can be easily adjusted over time

🤖 Existing Foundation

We already have:

• A working GoHighLevel CRM setup
• Integration with myCRMSIM for messaging infrastructure
• Foundational code and workflow logic that will be shared with applicants
• Existing outreach models we want to replicate and improve upon

One of the primary goals is to build an outbound AI texting and calling flow similar to systems currently used to:

• Contact Realtors
• Qualify interest and fit
• Book strategy/demo calls automatically

🧩 Required Integrations

The system must integrate with:

• VAPI (Voice AI platform)
• GoHighLevel CRM
• myCRMSIM messaging infrastructure (or recommended alternative)
• Make.com or n8n workflow automation
• Twilio or alternative telephony providers if needed
• Webhooks / API-based routing and automation

📞 Voice AI Requirements

The AI voice assistant must:

• Automatically call new leads after submission
• Conduct natural conversational qualification
• Handle inbound callbacks
• Detect voicemail and deploy voicemail drops
• Generate transcripts and structured data from conversations
• Escalate conversations to human agents when appropriate

💬 SMS AI Requirements

The SMS system must:

• Send automated SMS follow-up sequences
• Conduct two-way AI-driven text conversations
• Support outbound cold SMS campaigns to Realtors
• Qualify agent prospects via conversational texting
• Trigger appointment booking links or scheduling flows
• Escalate conversations to human sales staff when needed

🧠 Qualification Logic Requirements
Consumer Leads

AI should gather:

• Buyer vs seller intent
• Timeline to transact
• Price range / property preferences
• Financing status
• Current housing situation
• Appointment readiness

Realtor Prospecting

AI should:

• Introduce outreach naturally
• Confirm agent production level and experience
• Qualify interest in receiving leads
• Handle common objections
• Book onboarding or demo calls

⚙️ Workflow Automation Requirements

The system must include clean, scalable workflow logic built inside:

• Make.com OR
• n8n

Workflows should allow easy adjustment of:

• Messaging scripts
• Lead qualification criteria
• Routing rules
• Follow-up timing
• Campaign logic

📊 CRM Automation Requirements

Inside GoHighLevel, the system must:

• Update contact records automatically
• Apply tags and pipeline stages
• Trigger workflows and automations
• Assign leads to agents based on routing logic
• Trigger agent notifications and appointment booking

🧱 Technical Experience Required

Applicants should have strong experience with:

• VAPI or similar Voice AI platforms
• GoHighLevel automation and API integrations
• High-volume SMS infrastructure and compliance
• Make.com or n8n workflow automation
• Webhook and API-based integrations
• Conversational AI prompt and flow design
• Telephony systems such as Twilio or similar providers

🏡 Preferred Industry Experience

Strong preference given to candidates with experience in:

• Real estate CRMs or lead generation platforms
• Marketplace or lead distribution systems
• Appointment booking automation
• Multi-user CRM or SaaS platforms

🚀 Deliverables

• Fully functional AI voice bot integrated with VAPI
• Fully functional AI SMS bot integrated with GoHighLevel
• Outbound Realtor recruitment AI calling and texting flows
• High-volume outbound SMS infrastructure configuration
• Qualification scripts and conversational logic
• Lead routing and CRM workflow automation
• Testing and optimization support
• Documentation and training materials

🤝 Engagement Type

• Initial build project
• Strong opportunity for ongoing optimization and expansion
• Potential long-term AI automation partnership

⭐ Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

• Has built AI voice and SMS automation systems previously
• Understands CRM workflow automation architecture
• Can recommend best practices and system design improvements
• Communicates clearly and proactively
• Thinks long-term and scalability-first

📩 To Apply

Please include:

Examples of AI voice or SMS automation projects you have built

Experience with GoHighLevel, VAPI, or similar platforms

Experience with high-volume outbound SMS systems

Your recommended architecture for this project

Estimated timeline and build approach

Title: Build n8n Automation: TikTok/Instagram → AI Script → Avatar Video → Auto-Posting
Description:
I am looking for someone who can set up an N8N workflow that goes like this:

1. I send a TikTok or Instagram link to a Telegram bot
2. The bot will download the video with no watermark
3. The AI will analyze the video and make a transcript of it
4. Another AI will analyze the transcript and create a new transcript based on my prompt (I should be able to always adjust this prompt)
5. The script will be sent back to me on Telegram for approval, if I don't like it, I will ask for changes directly on telegram and the AI will make a new script. Repeat until I approve the final script.
6. A new video of an avatar reciting the approved script will be generated
7. The new avatar video will be overlaid on top of the old video.
8. The video will be sent back to me on telegram for approval.
9. Once approved, the video will be published on: YouTube shorts, Facebook, instagram, and TikTok.


To apply for this job, please answer the following questions:
1. What is 11+12? Please write the answer to this question in the first line of your application. This is how I filter SPAM.
2. What tools do you plan to use to create this flow?
3. Please give examples of further flows that you created in the past. Ideally, including N8N screenshots.
4. How long do you think it will take you to create this?
5. What should I expect each video to cost me in tokens?

Title: Automatically invoice my clients based on what subscription they are signed up for
Description:
We are seeking an experienced Automation Specialist to design and implement a system that automatically generates and sends monthly invoices to clients based on their subscribed plan.

Our business offers three paid subscription plans, and each client is tagged or recorded within our CRM according to the plan they are on. Your role will be to set up reliable automations so that invoices are created and sent automatically at the correct amount each month, without manual intervention.

This is a setup-focused role (not ongoing data entry), ideal for someone who enjoys building clean, efficient systems and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Review our existing CRM setup and subscription plan structure

Design and implement automated workflows that:

Identify each client’s subscribed plan in the CRM

Apply the correct monthly invoice amount based on that plan

Automatically generate and send invoices on a recurring schedule

Ensure invoices are accurate, consistent, and sent on time

Test automations thoroughly and troubleshoot any issues

Provide clear documentation or a walkthrough of how the system works

Required Skills & Experience

Proven experience setting up CRM automations

Strong understanding of automated billing or invoicing workflows

Experience with tools such as (or similar to):

Zapier / Make (Integromat)

CRM platforms (e.g. HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Airtable, etc.)

Invoicing or accounting tools (e.g. Xero, QuickBooks, Stripe, PayPal, etc.)

Attention to detail and a logical, systems-based mindset

Nice to Have

Experience with subscription-based billing models

Ability to suggest improvements or best-practice automation structures

Clear communication and ability to explain technical setups in plain English

Project Type

One-off setup project, with potential for future automation work if successful

How to Apply

A brief summary of similar automation or invoicing projects you’ve completed

Title: 📢 AI Voice & SMS Automation Developer
Description:
🧠 Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI automation developer to build and deploy an advanced AI voice and SMS outreach and lead qualification system for the real estate industry.

This project involves building both:

AI automation that follows up with inbound real estate leads

Outbound AI texting and calling automation that contacts real estate agents, qualifies them, and books sales calls

The system will integrate with VAPI, GoHighLevel, and high-volume SMS infrastructure, and must be designed for scalability, reliability, and long-term flexibility.

We are building a scalable real estate lead generation and marketplace ecosystem, so this project has strong long-term partnership potential.

🎯 Core Project Goals

The automation system will:

• Instantly call and text new inbound leads
• Qualify buyer and seller leads using AI conversations
• Route qualified leads to the correct real estate agents
• Book appointments automatically
• Conduct outbound AI calling and texting campaigns to recruit Realtors
• Qualify Realtors and book demo/sales calls
• Support high-volume cold SMS outreach in a compliant and scalable way
• Provide flexible workflow automation that can be easily adjusted over time

🤖 Existing Foundation

We already have:

• A working GoHighLevel CRM setup
• Integration with myCRMSIM for messaging infrastructure
• Foundational code and workflow logic that will be shared with applicants
• Existing outreach models we want to replicate and improve upon

One of the primary goals is to build an outbound AI texting and calling flow similar to systems currently used to:

• Contact Realtors
• Qualify interest and fit
• Book strategy/demo calls automatically

🧩 Required Integrations

The system must integrate with:

• VAPI (Voice AI platform)
• GoHighLevel CRM
• myCRMSIM messaging infrastructure (or recommended alternative)
• Make.com or n8n workflow automation
• Twilio or alternative telephony providers if needed
• Webhooks / API-based routing and automation

📞 Voice AI Requirements

The AI voice assistant must:

• Automatically call new leads after submission
• Conduct natural conversational qualification
• Handle inbound callbacks
• Detect voicemail and deploy voicemail drops
• Generate transcripts and structured data from conversations
• Escalate conversations to human agents when appropriate

💬 SMS AI Requirements

The SMS system must:

• Send automated SMS follow-up sequences
• Conduct two-way AI-driven text conversations
• Support outbound cold SMS campaigns to Realtors
• Qualify agent prospects via conversational texting
• Trigger appointment booking links or scheduling flows
• Escalate conversations to human sales staff when needed

🧠 Qualification Logic Requirements
Consumer Leads

AI should gather:

• Buyer vs seller intent
• Timeline to transact
• Price range / property preferences
• Financing status
• Current housing situation
• Appointment readiness

Realtor Prospecting

AI should:

• Introduce outreach naturally
• Confirm agent production level and experience
• Qualify interest in receiving leads
• Handle common objections
• Book onboarding or demo calls

⚙️ Workflow Automation Requirements

The system must include clean, scalable workflow logic built inside:

• Make.com OR
• n8n

Workflows should allow easy adjustment of:

• Messaging scripts
• Lead qualification criteria
• Routing rules
• Follow-up timing
• Campaign logic

📊 CRM Automation Requirements

Inside GoHighLevel, the system must:

• Update contact records automatically
• Apply tags and pipeline stages
• Trigger workflows and automations
• Assign leads to agents based on routing logic
• Trigger agent notifications and appointment booking

🧱 Technical Experience Required

Applicants should have strong experience with:

• VAPI or similar Voice AI platforms
• GoHighLevel automation and API integrations
• High-volume SMS infrastructure and compliance
• Make.com or n8n workflow automation
• Webhook and API-based integrations
• Conversational AI prompt and flow design
• Telephony systems such as Twilio or similar providers

🏡 Preferred Industry Experience

Strong preference given to candidates with experience in:

• Real estate CRMs or lead generation platforms
• Marketplace or lead distribution systems
• Appointment booking automation
• Multi-user CRM or SaaS platforms

🚀 Deliverables

• Fully functional AI voice bot integrated with VAPI
• Fully functional AI SMS bot integrated with GoHighLevel
• Outbound Realtor recruitment AI calling and texting flows
• High-volume outbound SMS infrastructure configuration
• Qualification scripts and conversational logic
• Lead routing and CRM workflow automation
• Testing and optimization support
• Documentation and training materials

🤝 Engagement Type

• Initial build project
• Strong opportunity for ongoing optimization and expansion
• Potential long-term AI automation partnership

⭐ Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

• Has built AI voice and SMS automation systems previously
• Understands CRM workflow automation architecture
• Can recommend best practices and system design improvements
• Communicates clearly and proactively
• Thinks long-term and scalability-first

📩 To Apply

Please include:

Examples of AI voice or SMS automation projects you have built

Experience with GoHighLevel, VAPI, or similar platforms

Experience with high-volume outbound SMS systems

Your recommended architecture for this project

Estimated timeline and build approach

Description:
Help automate my twice-weekly newsletter, PropaneInsider.com, which keeps US propane delivery pros—family-owned company owners, managers, CEOs, dispatchers, and leaders—up to date on industry buzz like pricing shifts, supply news, safety tips, and DOT rules. Output to Google Docs so we can edit if needed in the article QA process, pull feeds and create articles daily, but we schedule bi-weekly for newsletter to be mailed out.

You will build it but give me basic training so we can maintain it. Expect potential ongoing projects.

N8N experience (e.g., automation examples).
AI integration know-how (Gemini, Grok, etc.).
Workflow samples.
Availability (US Eastern Time preferred).
Time/cost estimate for the build.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced WooCommerce developer to build a Product Expiry Monitoring System for a client’s online shop.

📌 Project Overview
Our client operates a WooCommerce store that sells products with expiry dates. We need an automated system to:

1. Track product expiry dates inside WooCommerce
2. Notify the admin before products expire
3. Automatically move expiring products into the Sale section
4. Generate a newsletter draft listing expiring products

This system should run automatically in the background.

✅ Required Features

1. Expiry Date Field on Products
Add a custom expiry date field in the WooCommerce product editor
Admin can manually set the expiry date per product
2. Automated Expiry Alerts (Admin Notifications)
The system should send email alerts to the store admin:
- 60 days before expiry
- 30 days before expiry
The email should include a clear list of all products expiring within that timeframe.

3. Newsletter Draft Generation
When products are close to expiry, the system should automatically generate a pre-written newsletter draft including:
Product names
Price
Link to the Sale page
This draft will be used for marketing campaigns.

4. Automatic Sale Category Assignment
When a product reaches the expiry threshold (example: 60 days remaining):
Automatically add the product to the Sale category/section
(Optional: Discount logic can be discussed)

5. Expired Product Handling
Once expired, the product should be either:
Hidden from the shop, or
Marked as out of stock

6. Update-Safe & Stable Implementation (Very Important)
WooCommerce receives frequent updates, so the solution must be built in a way that is:
Fully compatible with future WooCommerce updates
Not dependent on theme files (must not break when the theme changes)
Implemented as a clean standalone plugin or modular system
Following WooCommerce best practices and hooks
Easy to maintain and extend long-term


We want to avoid any solution that could break after a WordPress/WooCommerce upgrade.

Documentation for how to use it

Title: AI Developer Needed for Innovative Legal Education Tool for Entrepreneurs
Description:
I'm building BlissBot, an AI-powered legal education companion for entrepreneurs. It guides users through a structured intake questionnaire about their business, asks smart follow-up questions based on their answers, and generates customized legal document templates (NDA, Client Services Agreement, Independent Contractor Agreement, Privacy Policy).
This is NOT a legal advice tool; it's an educational resource paired with a paid educational video program. Think of it as a guided self-assessment that helps business owners understand their legal foundations and walk away with starting-point documents.

Tech Stack (open to alternatives with justification)
Workflow/AI: n8n + Claude API (preferred) or OpenAI
Frontend: Bubble, Softr, or similar no-code platform
Auth: Access codes or magic links for cohort members
Docs: Template engine delivering DOCX and PDF downloads

What You're Building
Milestone 1 — Discovery & Architecture ($400–$500, 3–5 days)
Review the SOW, confirm your tech stack, set up the project environment, deliver a technical architecture document. This is a "prove the fit" phase — if it's not a match, we part ways here.
Milestone 2 — Core AI Conversation Flow ($700–$850, 7–10 days)
Build the guided questionnaire with branching logic across four topic areas: business entity, intellectual property, contracts, and compliance. Includes hard-coded guardrails — no legal advice framing, SSN/EIN input blocking, disclaimers, and scope boundary handling.
Milestone 3 — Document Template Generation ($600–$700, 5–7 days)
4 templates populated with user-specific data from the intake. Preview before download. DOCX and PDF output. No server-side document storage.
Milestone 4 — User Access, Polish & Launch ($500–$650, 5–7 days)
Authentication for cohort members, branded frontend (assets provided), mobile-responsive, session continuity, deployed to a live URL. One round of revisions.

Fix bugs from real user testing. No new features.
Security is non-negotiable. BlissBot must hard-block SSNs, EINs, and government IDs at the input level. Generated documents are download-only, never stored server-side. AI API usage must have data processing agreements preventing training on user data.
What's NOT in this MVP: Operating agreements, Terms of Service templates, USPTO database integration, admin dashboard, payment integration, or public-facing access. This is a focused v1 for cohort members only.
